name: CENCHRIS CONTORTRIX
key_symptoms: Forgetful, absent-minded, alternating moods. Aching pain in left frontal eminence and left side of teeth. Swelling around eyes, aching and itching in eyes.
Feels distended, fills whole chest, as if it fell down in abdomen; sharp stitches, fluttering under left scapula.
